claim: ADR 0288 (AW28, founder 2026-10-04 'Money / Stock (Recommended)', then 'Stock (Recommended)' and 'The floor (Recommended)'): on /recommendations the register files plowhorse_repricing (Price it) under Money, puzzle_activation (Move stock) under Stock, revenue_concentration under Stock and weekday_gap under The floor by rule name (rec-format.ts RULE_STAKE, read through readKey so composite stored keys on the leaves resolve), not under The floor from their efficiency category (nor revenue_concentration under Vendors from risk, nor weekday_gap under Money from sales); CATEGORY_STAKE has no efficiency key, and every rule(...) in recommendations.service.ts has either a RULE_STAKE row or a mapped category, so a new rule with an unmapped category fails here. The data hook files by stakeOf(ruleKey, category); a pressed register's section head carries rc-act-elsewhere and the working carries rc-register-why. Behaviour is pinned by rec-format.test.ts ('the register — filed by what acting on it changes'), RecommendationsNext.test.tsx and useRecommendationsNextData.test.tsx.
verify: python3 -c 'import re,sys; svc=open("apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/recommendations.service.ts").read(); d="apps/web/src/pages/recommendations/next/"; fmt=open(d+"rec-format.ts").read(); nxt=open(d+"RecommendationsNext.tsx").read(); hook=open(d+"useRecommendationsNextData.ts").read(); ent=open(d+"Entry.tsx").read(); blk=lambda n: (re.search(r"const "+n+r"\b[^=]*= \{(.*?)\n\};", fmt, re.S) or [None,""])[1]; rs=set(re.findall(r"^  ([a-z_]+): \{", blk("RULE_STAKE"), re.M)); cs=set(re.findall(r"^  ([a-z_]+): \x27", blk("CATEGORY_STAKE"), re.M)); ch=svc.split("rule(")[1:]; pairs=[(k[1],g[1]) for k,g in [(re.match(r"\s*[\"`]([a-z_]+)", c), re.search(r"category: \"([a-z_]+)\"", c)) for c in ch] if k and g]; bad=[p for p in pairs if p[0] not in rs and p[1] not in cs]; ok=[len(ch)>=18 and len(pairs)==len(ch), not bad, len(cs)>=8 and "efficiency" not in cs, bool(re.search(r"plowhorse_repricing: \{\s*stake: \x27money\x27", fmt)), bool(re.search(r"puzzle_activation: \{\s*stake: \x27stock\x27", fmt)), bool(re.search(r"revenue_concentration: \{\s*stake: \x27stock\x27", fmt)), bool(re.search(r"weekday_gap: \{\s*stake: \x27floor\x27", fmt)), bool(re.search(r"readKey\(ruleKey[^)]*\)\.ruleId", fmt)), "data-testid=\"rc-act-elsewhere\"" in nxt, "stakeOf(ruleKey, category)" in hook, "data-testid=\"rc-register-why\"" in ent]; print("unmapped", bad, "failed", [i for i,x in enumerate(ok) if not x]) if not all(ok) else None; sys.exit(0 if all(ok) else 1)'
